targets.rawSql: SELECT hour AS time, fleet_avg_conn_ms AS "Avg (ms)" FROM bt_hourly_fleet WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) ORDER BY hour
SELECT hour AS time, fleet_p99_conn_ms AS "P99 (ms)" FROM bt_hourly_fleet WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) ORDER BY hour
SELECT hour AS time, active_tvs AS "Active TVs" FROM bt_hourly_fleet WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) ORDER BY hour
SELECT device_type AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM bt_events WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY device_type ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: Slowest TVs (avg connection ms, last hour)

targets.rawSql: SELECT tv_id, ROUND(avg_conn_ms::numeric, 1) AS avg_ms, ROUND(p99_conn_ms::numeric, 1) AS p99_ms, event_count, unique_devices FROM bt_window_stats WHERE window_start >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' ORDER BY avg_conn_ms DESC LIMIT 20
